# attestation interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestationInterval`](gmeow-attestationInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestationInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The time interval over which the attested usage is asserted to have been observed — e.g. a corpus span, an inscription period, or a community usage era. A relator carries its period this way rather than via statement-level [`validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil alone.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestationInterval`](gmeow-attestationInterval.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to carry the time span over which the usage was observed — a corpus span, inscription period, or usage era — as a first-class interval on the relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one interval per attestation (it is functional) and avoid using bare statement-level [`validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil when the period belongs to the relator itself.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:attestationInterval`](gmeow-attestationInterval.md) once at a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) carrying its temporal frame; reify a separate attestation when a genuinely distinct span must be recorded.

### Examples

- ex:att1 [`gmeow:attestationInterval`](gmeow-attestationInterval.md) ex:lateMedievalSpan.
